Z Zabardast Biryani Rooted, rich and bold 2025

The logo draws on traditional South Indian temple and food signage, shaped into a bold, ornamental emblem that reflects biryani's cultural roots.

Five values guide the brand: authenticity, quality first, made with passion, value for money and community connection. The vision is to become the most loved Hyderabadi biryani brand.

Menus in English and Devanagari, a menu board for TV screens, packaging, uniforms and an illustrated tee line.
